description: COMBINE brief 30's n=1024 win (4fb45eec — single-CTA panel at threads=512 + UNIFORM TF32 trailing, skipping the per-matrix classify+argsort+gather; 1.093x geomean, n=1024 dense 1.39x/mixed 1.51x/nearrank 1.41x) onto the de-facto current best (d360cf57). Brief 30 measured the cluster is a NET NEGATIVE at n=1024 B=60 (the win is purely threads=512 + uniform-TF32, not the cluster). FIRST: integrate brief 30's n=1024 path (route n=1024 to single-CTA panel_factor<512> with uniform TF32 trailing — drop the cluster routing for n=1024). THEN extend the high-EV test: does uniform-TF32-WITHOUT-reorder also beat the parent's classify+gather split at n=512 B=640? Run the n=512 well-conditioned matrices' trailing as one whole-batch uniform TF32 cuBLAS GEMM (NO argsort/gather/inverse-permute), keeping ONLY band/rowscale/clustered (the matrices that fail TF32) on FP32 via a minimal device-flag correction. If the reorder overhead exceeds its benefit at n=512 like it did at n=1024, this wins 4 of 12 shapes. Per-matrix correctness must hold (invariance + diff_correctness 8 seeds). FP32 panel; no 'stream' substring.

STEP 1: integrate brief 30's n=1024 win onto parent A (d360cf57). Added a dedicated n==1024 branch in custom_kernel -> _blocked_qr(data, nb=32, mode=tf32, pthreads=512): single-CTA panel_factor<512> + UNIFORM TF32 trailing, NO classify/argsort/gather/inverse-permute. Dropped cluster routing for n=1024 (brief 30 measured cluster is a NET NEGATIVE at n=1024 B=60). Kept n=512 on _routed_qr; tiny-n/n=352/n=2048/n=4096 EXACTLY as parent A. 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. METRIC=clean light-mode geomean min 8197.9us (two clean runs 8197.9/8200.1; parent A clean equiv ~9000). IMMEDIATE back-to-back A/B vs parent A in BOTH orders -- n=512 anchor shapes 3/9/10 ratio ~1.505-1.510 = pure bimodal contention skew (code-independent; shapes 1/2/5/6 also unchanged show same ~1.47-1.50; shape0 n=32 ~1.0). Contention-NORMALIZED n=1024 wins: dense(shape4) 1.44-1.46x, mixed(shape8) 1.57-1.60x, nearrank(shape11) 1.43-1.44x -- matches brief 30 (1.39/1.51/1.41x). nsys n=1024 dense: panel_factor_kernel<512>=85.0pct (total GPU kernel time ~14.39ms, contention-immune, identical to brief 30 trial3), cluster kernel GONE, TF32 cutlass GEMMs ~14pct. Single-CTA panel<512> is the n=1024 wall.

STEP 2 first cut: reorder-free device-flag FP32 correction for the n=512/1024 mixed (heterogeneous) batch. Added trailing_correct_kernel + _MIXED_STRATEGY='correct': whole-batch uniform TF32 cuBLAS GEMM computed OUT-OF-PLACE into delta D (C untouched), then a device kernel corrects per matrix on the device class flag -- well: subtract cuBLAS TF32 delta; ill: from-scratch FP32 SIMT recompute. Kept all-well/all-ill paths + n_well.item() EXACTLY as parent (homogeneous shapes 3/9/10 unchanged); n=1024 = STEP 1. CORRECT: 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN (fixed a SMEM-overflow: Vstrip reused by Step W TC_BKW=16 + Step C TC_BMC=64 rows, sized for the larger). n=512 band scaled-resid 0.018/rowscale 0.045/mixed 11.5 << gate 20 -- FP32 correction load-bearing, holds. REGRESSION (clean A/B vs STEP 1, both light, anchor shapes 3/9/10 ratio ~1.000): n=512 mixed shape7 21310->31246us = 1.47x SLOWER; ALL other shapes ratio ~1.000 (only shape7 changed). geomean 8194->8469. The custom FP32 SIMT ill-recompute is much slower than cuBLAS (confirms briefs 5/26/27); ill matrices ALSO pay a WASTED TF32 cuBLAS GEMM (computed then thrown away) + the SIMT recompute. Reorder removal did not pay -- correction kernel cost > the gather it replaced. Next: profile shape7 to attribute time; consider (a) wmma TF32 well-subtract is moot (cuBLAS already did it), real cost is the FP32 ill GEMM -- could gather ONLY ill matrices (few) for a small cuBLAS FP32 call instead of the SIMT kernel, or (b) revert STEP 2, keep STEP 1's clean n=1024 win.

STEP 2 v2: reorder-free ILL-ONLY-gather correction (pure cuBLAS, no custom kernel). Replaced trial-2's full-delta-round-trip device kernel (it was 62pct of shape7 -- a B*n*n delta HBM round-trip every panel) with: factor WHOLE batch once uniform TF32 (fused in-place baddbmm), then RE-factor ONLY the ill minority in FP32 (small cuBLAS gather) + index_copy_ back. Removed trailing_correct_kernel (211 lines); diff vs STEP1 is now just _MIXED_STRATEGY='correct' + the ill-gather branch. CORRECT: 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. REGRESSION (clean A/B vs STEP1, both light-mode, anchors 3/9/10 ratio ~1.000): n=512 mixed shape7 21256->28497us = 1.34x SLOWER (vs trial-2 1.47x; improved but still a loss); ALL other shapes ratio ~1.000. geomean 8204->8407. ROOT CAUSE measured: the ill-only-gather RE-RUNS the full panel pipeline (panel kernel + trailing) for the ill subset; the parent's reorder does ONE panel pass + a per-panel trailing split, so ill-panel-re-factor cost > the reorder copy cost removed. The parent's reorder is well-chosen at n=512 B=640 (confirms brief 27 conclusion). STEP-1 n=1024 win intact (shape4/8/11 ~1.000). OPEN: (1) the per-panel split needs well-contiguous so the gather is intrinsic -- a reorder-free split would need a custom batched GEMM that does per-matrix precision in ONE pass without re-running the panel (brief 27 showed that custom GEMM is 2x slower); (2) shape7's reorder copy might be cut by gathering ONLY the trailing block per panel rather than the full B*n*n A+H once -- untried; (3) revert STEP 2, ship STEP 1 alone (clean 1.44-1.60x n=1024 win, geomean 8998->~8200).

FINAL (best) = STEP 1: reverted _MIXED_STRATEGY to 'reorder' (parent's n=512 mixed path), dropping the regressing STEP 2 reorder-free path. Both STEP-2 reorder-free implementations measured a clean 1.34-1.47x REGRESSION on the n=512 mixed shape (parent reorder is well-chosen at n=512 B=640; ill re-factor/delta-round-trip cost > the full B*n*n argsort+inverse-permute it removes -- confirms brief 27). Final HEAD is a CLEAN 32-line diff vs parent A: the dedicated n==1024 branch -> single-CTA panel_factor<512> + uniform TF32 trailing, cluster routing dropped for n=1024. No custom kernel, no 'stream'. 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. STEP-1 win CONFIRMED across THREE independent A/B rounds (light+deep contention modes, n=512 anchors used to normalize): n=1024 dense 1.44-1.46x, mixed 1.57-1.63x, nearrank 1.43-1.44x. Clean light-mode geomean min 8194us vs parent A ~8998 = ~1.097x whole-benchmark. nsys n=1024 dense (final SHA): single-CTA panel_factor<512>=85.0pct (total GPU kernel time ~14.4ms, contention-immune across all 4 n=1024 profiles), cluster kernel GONE, TF32 cutlass GEMMs ~14pct -- the single-CTA panel<512> is the n=1024 wall. OPEN DIRECTIONS for the manager: (1) the single-CTA panel_factor<512> is now 85pct of n=1024 and ncu-unprofiled -- a macro brief widening it (>512 threads = new launch_bounds template; or a B=60-tuned cluster-INSIDE-panel) is the next n=1024 wall; (2) STEP-2 reorder removal at n=512 is a measured dead end with these two implementations, BUT a reorder-free per-matrix-precision trailing in ONE pass without re-running the panel (needs a custom batched GEMM that does TF32-well/FP32-ill in a single kernel -- brief 27 found that 2x slower) was NOT achievable here; (3) the threads=512 single-CTA panel was not itself swept for n=1024 (only 128 vs 512 exist); an intermediate/per-n nb!=32 might shave the 85pct panel.

DONE (4 trials, HEAD=6d356551 = STEP 1 best). STEP 1 (integrate brief 30's n=1024 win onto parent A d360cf57) SUCCEEDED and is the deliverable: a CLEAN 32-line diff vs parent A -- a dedicated n==1024 branch routing to single-CTA panel_factor<512> + UNIFORM TF32 trailing (no classify/argsort/gather/inverse-permute), cluster routing dropped for n=1024. CONFIRMED across THREE independent back-to-back A/B rounds (light AND deep contention modes; n=512 anchor shapes 3/9/10 used to normalize the bimodal ~1.5x contention skew): n=1024 dense 1.44-1.46x, mixed 1.57-1.63x, nearrank 1.43-1.44x. Whole-benchmark clean light-mode geomean min 8194us vs parent A ~8998 = ~1.097x. 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN every trial. nsys n=1024 (4 captures, total GPU kernel time ~14.4ms contention-immune): single-CTA panel_factor<512> = 85.0pct (the NEW n=1024 wall), cooperative-cluster kernel GONE, TF32 cutlass GEMMs ~14pct.

STEP 2 (reorder-free uniform-TF32 at n=512 B=640) THOROUGHLY EXPLORED and is a MEASURED NEGATIVE -- 2 distinct implementations both REGRESSED the n=512 mixed shape (shape 7) in clean A/B (anchors ~1.000): (trial 2) device-flag FP32 correction via an out-of-place TF32 delta D + a device kernel (well: subtract D; ill: SIMT FP32 recompute) => 1.47x SLOWER; nsys attributed 62pct to the correction kernel -- a full B*n*n delta HBM round-trip EVERY panel. (trial 3) pure-cuBLAS ill-only gather (whole-batch TF32 in place, RE-factor the ill minority in FP32 + index_copy_ back, removed the 211-line kernel) => 1.34x SLOWER; root cause = re-running the full panel pipeline for the ill subset costs more than the reorder copies removed. Correctness was NOT the issue (both passed 22 tests + 3 guards incl. diff_correctness 8 seeds; band/rowscale/mixed n=512 scaled-resid 0.018/0.045/11.5 << gate 20 -- the FP32 ill correction is load-bearing and works). The PARENT'S REORDER IS WELL-CHOSEN at n=512 B=640: full-batch gather + per-panel TF32/FP32 split + inverse-permute (~1.3GB copies ~170us) beats any alternative that adds GPU work. This matches brief 27's independent conclusion (custom-GEMM trailing ~2x slower than cuBLAS). So unlike n=1024 (where the reorder removal won 1.5x on mixed), at n=512 the reorder overhead does NOT exceed its benefit.

OPEN DIRECTIONS the manager may pursue (none closed): (1) HIGHEST EV -- the single-CTA panel_factor<512> is now 85pct of n=1024 (3 of 12 shapes) and is ncu-UNPROFILED here; a macro brief that WIDENS it is the next n=1024 wall: >512 threads needs a new __launch_bounds__ template (currently only <128>/<256>/<512> instantiated; nwarps=16 is the red[] cap at 512, so >512 needs the reduction-scratch indexing reworked), OR a B=60-tuned cluster-INSIDE-panel, OR an intermediate threads value (only 128 vs 512 swept). (2) the threads=512 single-CTA panel was not swept for n=1024 at nb!=32 -- a wider/narrower cb might shave the 85pct panel. (3) STEP-2 reorder removal at n=512 needs a SINGLE-pass custom batched GEMM doing TF32-well/FP32-ill per matrix in ONE kernel WITHOUT re-running the panel and WITHOUT a full delta round-trip -- brief 27 measured such a custom GEMM ~2x slower, so this is a hard structural problem, not a quick win. (4) the same single-CTA-panel<512>+uniform-TF32 lever that won n=1024 has NOT been tried at n=2048 B=8 / n=4096 B=2 (currently on the cooperative cluster) as a cluster-vs-single-CTA-512 A/B. KEEP GOING -- the n=1024 single-CTA panel is the next thing to break.
